snippet.title: Besiege VR - Official Gameplay Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Besiege VR, a VR physics-based action sandbox game developed by 3R Games. Players will make use of a suite of tools to create catapults, tanks, ships, mechs, and more to lay waste to enemies in their path. Test and craft large scale creations in wide open environments in Besiege VR, coming in Summer 2025 for Meta Quest.
